integrity: All claims use the stated simplicial-complex definition; executable checks corroborate eight parameter instances, while the proof handles all allowed lengths.
scientific_limitations: For joins of three unfilled cycles of lengths at least four and direct simplicial three-tupling only; not a classification of arbitrary spheres, higher tuple sizes or equivariant homotopy. A literature search cannot exclude unindexed equivalences.
title: Parity phases and full graph homotopy types of three-tuplings of triple polygon joins
